integrity: Exact symbolic eight-state reduction, characteristic factorization, three verified initial moments and irrational-angle argument support infinite-m, infinite-t claims. Full-graph rational arithmetic reproduces 880 finite instances independently of the reduction. Finite verification does not establish infinite statements. The source numerical statement of exact unity is distinguished from near-unity. General transfer theorems remain a possible implicit source of coverage; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact result applies only to noiseless flip-flop walks with two marked negative-Grover body coins on the star-prism butterfly P2 Cartesian K1,m, normalized uniform outgoing initial and target arc states, and nonnegative integer m. It proves arbitrarily high fidelity but not perfect finite-time transfer for m at least two. Noise, finite-target-tolerance transfer times, other marks and other coin states are outside scope.
title: Exact transfer amplitude and sharp pretty-good-transfer trichotomy on butterfly quantum-walk networks
